event.desc: Concert celebrating the 300th anniversary of William Shakespeare.
The concert was attended by Hector Berlioz and his Danish pupil Asger Hamerik.

history.p: The overture was written around the turn of the year 1860/61. No less than three German publishing firms wanted to print it, but Gade chose Breitkopf & Härtel. The dedicatee was Gade's boyhood friend, the actor Frederik Høedt (1820-1885), who had had great success as Hamlet at The Royal Theatre in Copenhagen.

physDesc.physMedium: 1 single folio. Written in ink. Paper: 16 staves. Heading on fol.r: "Hamlet". On fol.v a sketch with the heading: "Landet fundet og forsvundet", for "Mindefest for N.P. Nielsen" (NWGW 191). 1 bifolio paginated 45-46 and 2 unnumbered pages corresponding to the same four pages in the autograph score. Written in ink. Paper: 18 staves.1 1/3 folio written in ink and pencil. Paper: 20 staves. Heading on fol.r: "III". At the top of fol.v dated: "Sylvester / 1860." After the last double bar-line on fol.v: "Fine 1 Januar 1861.".
